messages:
support_ae_maria: Hey team — Customer ACME (multi-tenant app) reporting intermittent p95 spikes from 200ms baseline to ~1.2s; they also saw increased billings for token overages last 24h. They gave a few request ids: r=acme-req-20260301-01, r=acme-req-20260301-07, r=acme-req-20260301-11. Can infra help collect a repro pack?

jamie: Thanks Maria. Do we have a reproducible curl or stress plan from the customer? Any concurrency / token sizes?

support_ae_maria: Customer shared a quick curl they run from prod CDN edge: 

```
curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "x-request-id: acme-req-20260301-07" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-13b","input":"<invoice_batch_v2>","max_tokens":512}'
```

Response sometimes 200 with slow tail and sometimes 504. No body error when 504.

sanjay: OK—we should collect: request logs (backend routing), per-host latency traces, kernel/gpu metrics for the time windows, and the customer's HAR if possible. Also need a promptset (they called it invoice_batch_v2). Ask them for 3 representative prompts with token counts.

tess: Maria — can you ask ACME for: 1) exact curl IDs (they gave some, ask for 10 if available), 2) a short list of 10 prompts that represent the mix, and 3) the times (TZ) when spikes were seen? Also request their concurrency pattern (clients/threads).

support_ae_maria: Asking now. ACME replied: concurrency burst ~120 concurrent streams, sustained 60 rps, avg input tokens ~180, avg generated tokens ~350 (so ~530 total). They attached 6 request ids and a sample prompt set (attached as `invoice_samples.txt`).

eng-infra-max: Good. Plan for repro pack:
- collect debug bundle for the time window containing the supplied req ids
- run a local stress replay using vegeta/hey to match their concurrency and token mix
- reproduce with two token profiles: small (total ~128) and large (total ~512+).

jamie: Can you post the exact vegeta command we want the test bench to run? We'll use it for reproducibility.

eng-infra-max: Vegeta example (ramp + steady state):

```
echo '{"method":"POST","url":"https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate","body":"{\"model\":\"gpt-open-13b\",\"input\":\"<PROMPT>\",\"max_tokens\":512}","header":{"Authorization":"Bearer $TOKEN","x-request-id":"test-$(date +%s)"}}' \
  | vegeta attack -rate=60 -duration=5m -connections=120 \
  | vegeta report
```

Replace <PROMPT> with items from invoice_samples.txt and run separate jobs for small/large token profiles.

pm-oliver: Add note: ensure we pin to same model version as customer (they said gpt-open-13b@v2.1). Quantization/variant matters.

support_ae_maria: ACME uploaded a small HAR + the prompt file to their shared folder: https://files.acme.example/pack/12345 (internal link). They also gave 10 request ids now: acme-req-20260301-01..10.

sanjay: I'm starting bundle collection for those ids. Command I will run internally: 

```
/internal/tools/collect-debug-bundle --req-ids acme-req-20260301-01,acme-req-20260301-02,acme-req-20260301-07 --window "2026-03-01T09:30:00Z/2026-03-01T10:30:00Z" --include=traces,host-metrics,gpu-stats,router-logs --out /tmp/acme-bundle-20260301.tar.gz
```

ops-bot: debug-bundle-create initiated by sanjay — bundle id db-98765, will be available at /internal/artifacts/db-98765.tar.gz when ready. :gear:

jamie: Once the bundle lands, please upload to the ticket and ping me. I'll kick off the vegeta runs in our lab infra and attach the request-id capture for comparison. Also capture p50/p95/p99.

eng-infra-max: Heads-up — if the issue is KV-cache cold starts on long prefix tails we might see token-length correlated p95 spikes. Include a test that replays repeated prefixes to warm caches.

support_ae_maria: ACME gave times: spikes at 09:41, 10:12, 10:44 UTC. They observed higher billings between 09:30-11:00. Asking if they can tolerate a short maintenance window for an instrumented replay.

pm-oliver: If we can repro at will we should coordinate a canary with dedicated routing so we don't affect other customers. Sanjay/Max can coordinate with infra to isolate.

sanjay: Bundle finished and uploaded: /internal/artifacts/db-98765.tar.gz. I extracted relevant router logs and attached a small excerpt: 

```
[2026-03-01T09:41:12Z] request_id=acme-req-20260301-07 route=host-13 latency_ms=1203 model=gpt-open-13b@v2.1 tokens_in=178 tokens_out=356 backend=pool-a
[2026-03-01T09:41:13Z] request_id=acme-req-20260301-07 routed_to=worker-42 kv_cache_hit=false gpu_ms=1120
[2026-03-01T09:41:13Z] request_id=acme-req-20260301-11 route=host-14 latency_ms=220 model=gpt-open-13b@v2.1 tokens_in=60 tokens_out=80
```

jamie: That first line looks like the p95 tail. I'll run vegeta matching the 178/356 token mix and a separate cold-cache run with repeated unique prefixes to verify kv_cache_hit=false effect.

eng-infra-max: Also capture host-level metrics during replay: nvidia-smi sampling, cpu, net, disk io. If we see GPU saturation (util>95%) at tails that indicates compute bottleneck. If not, check routing/backpressure.

support_ae_maria: ACME gave permission for a short repro window 11:00-11:15 UTC. They want us to notify them before the run.

jamie: I'll do the replay at 11:02 UTC. Pinging ops-bot to run the isolated canary route.

ops-bot: canary-route-init requested by jamie — canary id can-20260301-acme, route isolate=true, tokens=512, workers=120.

jamie: Replay done. Quick results: steady-state 60rps with concurrency 120, p50=210ms, p95=980ms for the large token profile; cold-cache variant p95 spiked to 1.25s. Full reports uploaded to /internal/reports/acme/2026-03-01/vegeta-summary.html

sanjay: Correlating replay results to logs: during spike windows backend worker 42 had repeated long-run GPU kernels. Looks compute-bound under load and cache cold effect amplifies tail.

pm-oliver: Action items: 1) short-term - recommend customer enable local prefix caching and reduce burst concurrency (or add token throttling), 2) mid-term - add KV-cache warmup heuristics and routing fallback to smaller model variant under tail pressure, 3) infra - investigate worker sizing and kernel optimizations for gpt-open-13b@v2.1.

support_ae_maria: I'll send ACME the replay summary, the vegeta reports, and recommended mitigations. Thanks everyone — marking issue as in-progress on the ticket. :white_check_mark:

jamie: Nice work. Closing loop after infra has a follow-up patch or we have a mitigated config.

ops-bot: ticket update: TICKET-5423 status=investigating assignee=support_ae_maria attachments=[/internal/artifacts/db-98765.tar.gz,/internal/reports/acme/2026-03-01/vegeta-summary.html]
